A few months back I posted about how voat's broken thumbnails issue was linked to a request.timeout value that was too low. While this still stands true (for the occasional links pointing to large images or slow websites) my assessment seems to have been slightly superficial.

As we all know, voat thumbnails work only sporadically for gfycat.com and not at all for imgur .gifv links. After many hours researching, here's why:

  • Gfycat.com: the og:image is served to Voat's OpenGraph parser as a scaled-down gif and not a jpeg. Gifs can be large files, and this puts extra load onto voats server having to wait, receive, and transform the gif into a thumbnail. And testing shows that sometimes gfycat doesn't even have their scaled-down gif ready for the OpenGraph parser (which is why voat users have been reporting that deleting and reposting a gfycat link will eventually return a thumbnail).

  • Imgur gifs: Voat's OpenGraph parser seems to have an issue with the 'https' on the og:image thumb url provided by imgur on gifv pages. This seems to be because the parser is reading from a non-https page. Imgur images (through the imgur UI) use a http og:image url, so there is no issue when posting to voat. This is the most feasible explanation, though I could be wrong here.

Either way, I think it's important to patch these specific domain-related issues - as sharing imgur and gfycat links are an essential part of the great user experience that voat provides.

So - after many more hours coding and testing, here's the fix:

Within the ThumbnailFromSubmissionModel method in ThumbGenerator.cs the following code blocks should be added:

 // workaround variables for thumbs not being created on imgur .gifv and gfycat links
 var uri = new Uri(submissionModel.Content);
 string host = uri.Host;

 if (extension == ".gifv" && host == "i.imgur.com")
 {
 try
 {
 // reformat & append uri to point to imgur jpeg thumb location
 string imgurThumbLocation = "https://i.imgur.com/" + Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(uri.Segments[1]) + ".jpg";
 var thumbFileName = await GenerateThumbFromUrl(imgurThumbLocation);
 return thumbFileName;
 } 

 if (host == "gfycat.com")
 {
 try
 {
 // reformat & append uri to point to gfycat jpeg thumb location
 string gfycatThumbLocation = "https://thumbs.gfycat.com/" + Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(uri.Segments[1]) + "-mobile.jpg";
 var thumbFileName = await GenerateThumbFromUrl(gfycatThumbLocation);
 return thumbFileName;
 }

The fully re-written method can be found here: http://pastebin.com/yhqKDMtj

Testing shows that this code works and thumbs now always appear for both gfycat.com and imgur gifv links. The best part is that when posting gfycat links it now loads super fast, as the server only has to resize a jpeg instead of a whole gif file.

I hope this helps, and please feel free to comment/suggest edits on my code.

EDIT:

  • Imgur: perhaps remove the extension == ".gifv" so that this part includes .mp4 links and any pages linked through the imgur full website UI (ie. when the url doesn't end with an extension)
  • Gfycat: maybe add a while loop to attempt the try statement a couple of times when the gfycat server doesn't respond.
